senses.gloss: f. (נטר, cmp. אִטְּרִי) preserve, pickle, esp. salted or pickled fish.
units: Meg. 6ᵃ טמוני זו ט׳ ‘stored things’ (Deut. XXXIII, 19) refers to tarith (as a valuable article of commerce); Sifré Deut. 354; Num. R. s. 13.—
Ab. Zar. II, 6 ט׳ טרופה brine containing hashed tarith (when you cannot recognize the clean and unclean fish).
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ט׳ שאינה טרופה</he> in which the fish can be recognized.
Ned. VI, 4 he who vows abstinence from ‘fish’ מותר בט׳ טרופה is permitted to partake of hashed t.
